title: Distance traveled by the Hunga Tonga pressure wave vs the Moon

source.name: NOAA Pacific Marine Environmental Laboratory, Hunga Tonga eruption pressure wave analysis

notes: NOAA PMEL recorded the eruption's atmospheric pressure wave circling the Earth 3 times before dissipating. At Earth's circumference of about 24,901 miles, that's roughly 74,700 miles traveled -- almost a third of the average 238,900-mile distance to the Moon.
